content: The equity overweight is trimmed on valuation alone. At elevated price-to-earnings multiples against a decelerating earnings-revision breadth, the risk/reward for adding duration here is unattractive. Sticky core inflation and a hawkish Fed reaction function argue for trimming duration risk and rotating from high-multiple growth toward quality-defensive equity. Credit remains well-bid but spreads have begun to widen in high yield.
